verdict.rationale: Godot's core identity is a visual editor built around a Node/Scene composition system (scenes act as prefabs), inspector for property editing, and viewport for level/scene building, well documented across docs (scene system, import pipeline, plugins extending editor tools) and corroborated by community users praising it as 'a visual editor but still be able to code' compared favorably to more code-heavy alternatives. missing for 10: no dedicated hands-on walkthrough of viewport/inspector UI specifics or prefab-equivalent scene-instancing workflow details, and some community comments note friction for beginners with non-visual-scripting workflows.
